#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Builds the static website version of Retal into public-html/.
# Upload that folder to any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, an S3 bucket...).
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

# 1. compile the game for the browser (also refreshes web/)
./build_web.sh

# 2. copy the site files
mkdir -p public-html
for f in index.html mq_js_bundle.js tilt.js net.js retal.wasm; do
    cp "web/$f" "public-html/$f"
done
# keep a config.js the person already edited (it holds the multiplayer server address)
if [ ! -f public-html/config.js ]; then
    cp web/config.js public-html/config.js
fi
# GitHub Pages: serve files as-is (no Jekyll processing)
touch public-html/.nojekyll

echo "Static site ready in public-html/ ($(du -sh public-html | cut -f1))"

# Example GitHub Actions workflow that publishes app/public-html to GitHub Pages.
# To use it: copy this file to .github/workflows/pages.yml at the top of your repository,
# then in the repository settings choose Pages -> Source: "GitHub Actions".
# (If the game lives somewhere other than app/, change the path below.)
name: Publish Retal to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: app/public-html
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# Hosting Retal as a static website

`public-html/` is the complete website: `index.html`, the game (`retal.wasm`), three small scripts and `config.js`.
It has no server code, so any static host works, and it runs from a sub-folder too (for example
`https://<you>.github.io/<repo>/`).

Rebuild it after changing the game: `./build_static.sh`

## GitHub Pages
Pick one:
- **Simplest:** commit `app/public-html/`, then in the repository go to Settings → Pages and either
  copy its contents to a `docs/` folder on your main branch and choose "Deploy from a branch → /docs",
  or use the workflow below.
- **Workflow:** copy `deploy/github-pages.yml` to `.github/workflows/pages.yml` in your repository and set
  Settings → Pages → Source to "GitHub Actions". Every push publishes `app/public-html`.

GitHub Pages uses https, so phone tilt controls work there.

## Multiplayer on a static site
A static host can't run the match server, so solo play works everywhere, and multiplayer needs a
Retal match server running somewhere (`cargo run --release --bin retal-server` on a computer or a
small cloud machine).

- Put its address in `public-html/config.js`, e.g. `var RETAL_SERVER = "wss://retal.example.com/ws";`
- A page on https (like GitHub Pages) can only use a **wss://** (secure) server address, so put the
  server behind HTTPS (for example with Caddy or nginx as a reverse proxy).
- Players can also type an address in the lobby (SERVER ADDRESS), or open the page as
  `index.html?server=wss://retal.example.com/ws`. The last address that worked is remembered on each device.

{
  "name": "Retal - Endless Arcade Air Combat",
  "short_name": "Retal",
  "description": "Endless arcade jet combat. Tilt your phone to fly.",
  "start_url": "./index.html",
  "scope": "./",
  "display": "fullscreen",
  "orientation": "landscape",
  "background_color": "#0b1a3a",
  "theme_color": "#0b1a3a",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "icon-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
    { "src": "icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" }
  ]
}

import sys
from PIL import Image
root = sys.argv[1]
im = Image.open(root + '/assets/generated/title.png').convert('RGB')
w, h = im.size
# square crop around the jet on the right side of the art
side = int(h * 0.62)
cx, cy = int(w * 0.70), int(h * 0.60)
box = (max(0, cx - side // 2), max(0, cy - side // 2), min(w, cx + side // 2), min(h, cy + side // 2))
sq = im.crop(box)
for size in (192, 512):
    sq.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS).save(f'{root}/web/icon-{size}.png', optimize=True)
print(box)

import sys, json
root = sys.argv[1]
m = json.load(open(root + '/mechanics.json'))
v = [d for d in m['values'] if d['group'] != 'mobile']
for n, val, u in [
    ("tilt sensitivity choices", "LOW / NORMAL / HIGH (pause screen)", None),
    ("tilt angle multiplier LOW / NORMAL / HIGH", "1.4 / 1.0 / 0.7", None),
    ("tilt smoothing (share of each new reading)", 0.35, None),
    ("tilt re-levels when the phone is turned", True, None),
    ("no tilt reading within", 4, "s (then drag-to-steer is offered)"),
    ("phone view distance (ground patches)", 22, "cells of 500 m"),
    ("computer view distance (ground patches)", 34, "cells of 500 m"),
    ("screen kept awake while playing on phones", True, None),
]:
    d = {"name": n, "group": "mobile", "value": val, "estimated": True}
    if u:
        d["unit"] = u
    v.append(d)
m['values'] = v
json.dump(m, open(root + '/mechanics.json', 'w'), indent=1)

md = open(root + '/MECHANICS.md').read()
if '## Phones (static website)' not in md:
    md += '''
## Phones (static website)

| Value | Amount | Source |
|---|---|---|
| tilt sensitivity | LOW / NORMAL / HIGH on the pause screen (full stick at 1.4x / 1x / 0.7x the normal 26 deg roll, 23 deg pitch) | estimated |
| tilt smoothing | each reading moves the stick 35 % of the way (removes sensor jitter) | estimated |
| re-level | automatic when the phone is turned; LEVEL button any time | estimated |
| view distance on phones | 11 km (computers 17 km) | estimated |
| screen | kept awake while playing; game area avoids notches | estimated |
'''
    open(root + '/MECHANICS.md', 'w').write(md)

sh = open(root + '/deploy/STATIC-HOSTING.md').read()
if '## Phones' not in sh:
    sh += '''
## Phones
- Open the site on the phone, hold it sideways and tap START. iPhones ask for "Motion & Orientation" access:
  allow it, that is the tilt steering. The angle you hold the phone at when you tap FLY becomes level;
  the LEVEL button re-levels any time, and turning the phone re-levels automatically.
- Tilt too twitchy or too slow? Pause (II) and tap TILT: LOW / NORMAL / HIGH.
- "Add to Home Screen" (Share menu on iPhone, browser menu on Android) installs Retal as a full-screen app.
- Tilt only works on https pages; GitHub Pages is https.
- Phones draw a shorter, foggier view to keep the game smooth, and the screen stays on while you play.
'''
    open(root + '/deploy/STATIC-HOSTING.md', 'w').write(sh)
print("ok")

params.text: Static site: app/public-html (built by ./build_static.sh -> runs build_web.sh then copies index.html, config.js (kept if edited), mq_js_bundle.js, tilt.js, net.js, retal.wasm, manifest.webmanifest, icon-192/512.png, .nojekyll). Works from a sub-folder on a plain static server (tested headless). Multiplayer on static hosts: server address from ?server=, config.js RETAL_SERVER, last working address (localStorage), else same-origin /ws; https pages need wss://. deploy/STATIC-HOSTING.md + deploy/github-pages.yml (example workflow to copy into .github/workflows). Mobile tuning: tilt.js smoothing 0.35, re-level on screen rotation (epoch), tilt state (waiting/on/blocked/none) shown on title, wake lock, safe-area canvas, PWA manifest; Rust: tilt sensitivity LOW/NORMAL/HIGH on pause screen (touch), phone draws 22-cell ground radius + 5 mountain tiles with shorter fog. Self-test now uses 20 sim steps per drawn frame and no vsync in test modes (fixes >90 s timeouts when the window is covered); runs in <1 s. Not tested on a real phone.
